10.1038/s41467-026-77963-6.title: Fig. 2: Round-by-round performance of AI-generated T-domain variants in the minimal system producing 1 and 2.
10.1038/s41467-026-77963-6.caption: a Production of 1 and 2 for variants tested in round 1–3, expressed in E. coli and screened in succinate XPP medium at the 1 mL scale, shown relative to the WT GxpS_T3 control included in each experiment (WT = 100%). Bars represent mean values, and error bars indicate ± standard deviation (SD) ( n = 3 biological replicates); points indicate individual replicates. Complete raw and processed datasets underlying all experiments are provided in Source Data and Supplementary Data 1 , respectively. Quantification was performed by LC-MS using external calibration with synthesized or purified standards (see Supplementary Fig. 2 ). b , Violin plots summarizing the distribution of activities for each round. Violin plots show the distribution of normalized production levels for variants tested in each design round. The shape of the violin plot reflects the probability distribution of activity values, i.e., the density of variants exhibiting that level of activity, with wider regions indicating a higher frequency of observations. Within each violin, the dashed line indicates the median and the dotted lines the 25th and 75th percentiles; the violin spans the full range of the observed values. Sample sizes are as in ( c ). c Fraction of variants exceeding the indicated activity thresholds. Sample sizes: round 1 ( n = 11), round 2 ( n = 25), round 3 ( n = 30). Source data are provided as a Source Data file.

10.1126/sciadv.aef6263.title: Versatile perception via a minimalist single-ended MMF.
10.1126/sciadv.aef6263.caption: Versatile perception via a minimalist single-ended MMF. ( A ) Hardware complexity in traditional sensing methods. ( B ) Topological constraints of conventional dual-ended MMF sensing, where the transmission loop hinders minimally invasive integration. ( C ) Minimalist architecture of the proposed single-ended integration. The reflective design eliminates distal hardware dependencies, enabling a compact sensing interface. ( D ) Speckle-based shape encoding mechanism within a constrained environment. Deformation modulates internal mode coupling, mapping specific geometric shapes ( K 1 , K 2 , and   K 3 ) to unique high-dimensional speckle fields. ( E ) Versatile neural perception modes decoded from a single interface. The system spans discrete point-wise state confirmation (e.g., stable grasping with soft arms), continuous line-wise shape tracking (e.g., dexterous manipulation), and 3D surface-wise reconstruction (e.g., navigation of vascular interventional robots).
10.1126/sciadv.aef6263.title_zh: 单端多模光纤与软体机器人形态感知
10.1126/sciadv.aef6263.caption_zh: 反射式单端光纤省去远端连接设备，将弯曲形态编码为不同的散斑图样，再用神经网络解码。图中展示点状态识别、连续轨迹跟踪和三维表面重建三种感知方式。

10.1038/s41524-026-02307-3.title: Fig. 1 · 原文配图
10.1038/s41524-026-02307-3.caption: Fig. 1 | Thermoelectric inverse design (TEID) combines databases, generative modeling and hierarchical ﬁrst-principles screening to discover functional materials. a MatHub-3d provides the crystal-structure database used for model training. b Machine-learning-driven generative models pro- pose new candidate structures. c High-throughput calculations at increasing levels of accuracy assess the generated candidates. d High-throughput (HTP) screening progressively reduces the candidate set. e Accurate calculations of functional properties identify novel thermoelectric materials. Pale-blue arrows indicate the workﬂow direction; blue labels identify the data and computational stages, whereas red labels emphasize the screening and ﬁnal-output stages.
10.1038/s41524-026-02307-3.title_zh: 生成模型驱动的热电材料逆向设计流程
10.1038/s41524-026-02307-3.caption_zh: 从 MatHub-3d 晶体数据库训练生成模型，提出候选结构，再以逐级提高精度的高通量计算检查稳定性和功能性质。经过筛选与精确计算，得到候选热电材料，形成“数据库—生成—计算—筛选—验证”的流程。
